governing_rule: Generation may vary; qualification standards must not.

reference_frameworks.name: Quality Matters Higher Education Rubric, Seventh Edition v2.0
reference_frameworks.observed: Eight general standards; alignment across objectives, assessment, materials, activities, technology, support, accessibility/usability; QM certification requires all essential standards and 85 percent overall.

reference_frameworks.name: Quality Matters Continuing and Professional Education Rubric, Third Edition
reference_frameworks.observed: Professional/pass-fail/skills-based course design uses eight general standards and essential-standard plus overall-score review.

reference_frameworks.name: ACE Learning Evaluations
reference_frameworks.observed: College-credit recommendations require external faculty review of workplace learning programs against academic standards; resulting recommendations may be used by colleges and universities.

reference_frameworks.name: ANAB Certificate Accreditation / ANSI-ASTM E2659-24
reference_frameworks.observed: Certificate-program accreditation includes instructional design, valid and reliable assessment, criterion-referenced passing standards, and continuous quality improvement.

reference_frameworks.name: Standards for Educational and Psychological Testing (AERA/APA/NCME, 2014)
reference_frameworks.observed: Authoritative testing guidance includes validity, fairness, workplace testing and credentialing, and technology/automated-scoring concerns.
